# Site Name
> Pashora Shop

## About
Pashora Shop is a premium Bangladeshi e-commerce platform offering authentic gadgets, fashion, lifestyle, and home appliance products. We serve customers all over Bangladesh with Cash on Delivery (COD) and fast home delivery.

## Products
- Gadgets & Electronics
- Fashion (Men, Women, Kids)
- Home Appliances & Kitchen
- Lifestyle & Personal Care
- Sports & Fitness
